continue_state_hint: Continue from the last step or loaded snapshot. Run starts a fresh simulation.
simulation_step_hint: Advance one step. Start with the first step for a new or completed simulation.
example_save_copy: Examples are protected. Save a copy in another directory.
example_rc-sine: RC circuit with a sine source
example_rc-pulse: RC circuit with a pulse source
example_rc-table: RC circuit with a tabulated source
example_rc-sweep: RC circuit — R and C sweep
experiment_end: Measurement end, s (-1 means final time)
experiment_empty: This project has no experiment sweeps.
adaptive_hint: With adaptation off, the top toolbar sets the fixed step. With adaptation on, it sets the maximum; the solver reduces it according to the error estimate. Switching events and the recording start are reached exactly.
adaptive_statistics:
Accepted step: %1 … %2 s
Maximum estimated error / tolerance: %3
Reduction reason: %4
expression_hint: Write C initialization code with named circuit variables. Functions, branches, and instruction-bounded loops are available. Numeric element fields can use the resulting variables; expressions use internal units without text suffixes.
initial_warmup_error: Warm-up must be nonnegative and shorter than stop time.
initial_hint: Zero mode clears C/L energy and diode charge. DC finds equilibrium at source and gate values at t = 0. Warm-up is not recorded in plots; time remains absolute, progress and Stop stay available. Zero disables warm-up.
snapshot_loaded: State loaded · t = %1 s · Continue or take a single step
hint: Drag blocks and ports. Ctrl + drag a wire to branch. Esc cancels.
recovery_available: A recovery copy is available. Recover opens it as an unsaved circuit.
place_hint: Click to place; Space rotates; Ctrl+M mirrors; Esc cancels.
name: Name
wire_color_hint: Left-click to choose an RGB color; right-click to restore the automatic net color
parameter_from_parent: Value is provided by the parent block parameter: %1
scope_title: Waveforms · Left: cursor A, right: cursor B, wheel: zoom
scope_empty: Select channels and run the simulation
wire_hint: Drag to a port or wire. Release on empty canvas to extend. Esc cancels.
recovered: Recovery copy restored. Save the circuit to a file of your choice.
error_hint: An error occurred. Select a diagnostic message to locate its element.
warning_hint: The operation completed with a warning. Details are available in Diagnostics.
stopping: Stopping after the current time step…
events_format: Enter time in seconds and state 0 or 1 in the table, e.g. 1e-3 and 1.
events_paste_hint: Paste two columns, pair lines, or an array such as {{0,0},{1e-3,1}} with Ctrl+V.
bends_format: Enter one x y coordinate pair per line.
positive_time: Duration and time step must be positive.
scope_disabled:
Oscilloscope is off
No sample history is collected. Enable recording and choose channels before starting.
diagnostics_hint: Circuit validation and simulation messages appear here.
junction_hint: Click to place a junction, or start a connection directly from a terminal.
record_next_run: The selected channel will be recorded on the next run.
plot_navigation: Click the active zoom icon again to pan with the left button. Wheel: XY; Ctrl: X; Shift: Y. Middle button always pans.
plot_connect_hint: Connect probe outputs or gate signals to this plot, then press Start.
inspector_empty: Select an element or wire to edit its properties.
empty_steps: Double-click to find a block. Drag ports to connect.
result_outdated: Model changed — run again to update results
gate_replace_text: This switch already has scheduled events or a connected control source. Replace them with the new connection? Undo will restore the previous control settings.
gate_connected_source: Controlled by: %1. Edit switching parameters in the connected source.
component_bar_hint: Click to place a component. Right-click a library component to pin it here.
junction_pass: Pass-through node. Delete joins both wires without breaking the circuit.
zoom_axis: Zoom %1: drag to select a range. Click again to turn Zoom off and pan with the left button.
cursor_place_hint: Choose A or B, a signal and a point on the plot.
cursor_frequency_hint: 1/|Δt| is the reciprocal cursor interval. It is the signal frequency only when the interval spans one complete cycle.
wheel_conflict: X and Y require different modifiers.
label_hint: Label: drag to move, Space to rotate; double-click to edit.
measure_hint: Analog traces use linear interpolation; gates hold until the next sample. Minimum, maximum and median use recorded samples.
spectrum_hint: A fundamental of 0 disables THD. Phase is relative to the interval start. FFT uses uniform interpolation without anti-alias filtering; verify the spectrum with more FFT points and a smaller original recording step.
spectrum_missing_signal: This signal is absent from the current recording. Reopen the spectrum window to select another signal.
spectrum_thd_unavailable: unavailable (requires whole periods and a nonzero fundamental)
spectrum_summary:
%1 … %2 s · Fs: %3 · Δf: %4
THD: %5 · harmonics included: %6
spectrum_sampling: Recorded points in range: %1. Largest interpolation interval used: %2.
invalid_spectrum_options: Check the interval, FFT size and harmonic count.
insufficient_spectrum_data: Insufficient recorded data in the selected interval.
insufficient_spectrum_periods: Select at least one fundamental period.
spectrum_nyquist: Fundamental must be below half the FFT sampling frequency. Increase the point count.
energy_hint: Select voltage in the Signal field above and current through the same branch. Positive power means consumption with consistent voltage and current directions.
energy_choose_channels: Select voltage and record or connect a current channel to this graph.
trigger_level_hint: Trigger level. Drag the horizontal T line on the plot.
trigger_position_hint: Event position in the window, %. Drag the vertical T line.
time_span_hint: Sliding time window, e.g. 100 ms or 0.1 s. 0 shows all data. Editing enables follow; panning and zoom pause it.
channel_source_hint: Select the name to highlight its source in purple on the schematic. The checkbox controls recording separately.
hide_signal: %1 — click to hide this trace. Recording and export are preserved.
all_signals_hidden: All traces are hidden. Click a signal name with an eye icon above the plot.
measurement_peak_bounds: Excursion and distance must be non-negative
measurement_reference_bounds: Low < high; 0 <= lower reference < upper reference <= 100
measurement_axis_bounds: X min >= 0; min < max; span >= 0; 0 < line width <= 10
trigger_bounds: Holdoff >= 0; position must be between 0 and 100%.
curve_rename_hint: Double-click the name to rename. Enter saves, Esc cancels. An empty name restores the original.
curve_style_error: Width: greater than 0 and up to 10 px. Marker: 1–24 px.
definition_readonly: Read only — choose Edit shared definition to make changes
definition_shared: Shared definition: edits affect linked instances
editing_shared_definition: Editing a shared definition. To change just one instance, use Make local copy on its parent level first.
samples_format: Enter time and value on each row, for example: 1ms 5V
import_samples_hint: Load two columns: time and value. Review the table and click Apply.
resistor_description: Ohmic resistance between p and n. Set the resistance; current and voltage follow Ohm's law.
capacitor_description: Electrical charge storage between p and n. Set capacitance and an optional initial voltage or charge.
inductor_description: Magnetic energy storage between p and n. Set inductance and the initial branch current.
voltage_source_description: Ideal prescribed voltage source. Select DC, sine, pulse, or PWL and configure its waveform.
current_source_description: Ideal prescribed current source from p to n. Select DC, sine, pulse, or PWL and configure its waveform.
switch_description: Controlled bidirectional switch. Connect a gate signal or use its event table; PWL mode exposes Ron and Roff.
diode_description: Power diode that commutates from circuit voltage and current. Ideal, PWL, and recovery-charge models are available.
voltage_probe_description: Non-loading voltage measurement between p and n. Connect out to a plot or Scope.
current_probe_description: Ideal series current measurement between p and n. Insert it into a branch and connect out to a plot.
thyristor_description: A gate pulse latches the thyristor until load current falls below holding current. Configure its model and initial state.
igbt_channel_description: Controlled IGBT channel without an internal reverse diode. Add a diode or use the complete IGBT module.
mosfet_module_description: Editable MOSFET with a separate body diode. Open the subsystem or edit its public channel and diode parameters.
igbt_module_description: Editable IGBT with a separate reverse diode. Gate controls the channel; channel and diode parameters remain accessible.
diode_bridge_1p_description: Single-phase uncontrolled four-diode rectifier. Connect AC to the ~ inputs and the load to DC+ and DC−.
diode_bridge_3p_description: Three-phase uncontrolled six-pulse rectifier. Connect A/B/C and the DC link to DC+/DC−.
thyristor_bridge_1p_description: Single-phase controlled four-thyristor bridge. Supply coordinated gate pulses and configure thyristor parameters.
thyristor_bridge_3p_description: Three-phase six-pulse thyristor bridge. Six gate inputs define firing angle and commutation sequence.
buck_module_description: Step-down DC/DC converter. Connect supply, load, and gate, then configure L, C, ESR, and initial states.
boost_module_description: Step-up DC/DC converter. Connect source, load, and gate, then configure its inductor, capacitor, and losses.
buck_boost_module_description: Inverting buck-boost converter. Gate defines switching while L/C and initial states define transients.
half_bridge_module_description: Power leg with upper and lower switches. Use complementary gates with dead time to prevent shoot-through.
full_bridge_module_description: Two-leg H-bridge for bipolar load voltage. Configure four gate signals and enforce dead time.
bidirectional_module_description: Bidirectional DC/DC based on a common half bridge. Two gates and L/C parameters control energy flow.
precharge_module_description: DC-link precharge path with a limiting resistor and bypass. Close the bypass only after safe charging.
dc_link_module_description: DC-link capacitance with ESR. Set capacitance, loss, and initial voltage to model stored bus energy.
switched_resistor_module_description: Switched discharge or braking resistor. Gate connects the resistor to the DC bus to dissipate energy.
ac_voltage_controller_description: Single-phase controller using antiparallel thyristors. Two gates define firing angles for both half-cycles.
ac_voltage_controller_3p_description: Three-phase AC controller using six thyristors. Supply positive and negative firing pulses for each phase.
vsi_2l_module_description: Two-level three-phase inverter. Six external gates drive three legs; enforce complementary states and dead time.
npc_3l_module_description: Three-level NPC inverter with a split DC link. Twelve gates form positive, zero, and negative phase levels.
open_end_winding_module_description: Two three-phase inverters feed both winding ends. Configure twelve gate signals and the common DC bus.
three_phase_switch_description: Three-pole controlled switch. One gate connects or opens phases A/B/C together.
ground_description: Electrical reference potential. Grounds join only when their complete names match, so GND and GND2 remain separate.
node_description: Explicit wire junction. It is normally created by branching or with Ctrl+W.
gate_pattern_description: Discrete gate source. In C mode select up to 16 outputs and write them as IN[ind]; stime contains the current simulation time.
gate_script_description: Programmable safe-C gate source. One output uses return 0/1; multiple outputs use IN[ind], with stime updated every simulation step.
pwm_description: Constant PWM source with frequency, duty, and delay. Edges are scheduled exactly and do not depend on recording step.
plot_description: Independent plot for up to 16 analog or gate signals. Open it for scaling, cursors, and export.
differential_plot_description: Plots the difference of paired + and − inputs. Use it for line and phase-to-phase voltage without loading the circuit.
tag_description: Wireless connection for equally named nets. Select domain and scope; graphical crossings alone never connect.
three_phase_source_description: Wye-connected three-phase source with neutral N. Configure voltage convention, magnitude, frequency, and phase.
three_phase_source_delta_description: Delta-connected three-phase source. Configure line or phase voltage, frequency, and phase offset.
appearance_image_error: The image could not be read or stored.
scope_probe_already_disconnected: The observed conductor was already disconnected. The remaining orphaned measurement branch was removed safely.
unexpected_internal_error: An unexpected internal error was stopped safely. The current operation was cancelled.
code_block_description: A periodic safe C block with typed signal and gate inputs and outputs.
code_block_single_selection: Select one code block to edit it.
code_block_schedule_error: The period must be positive and the initial delay non-negative.
code_block_output_required: Enter code and define at least one output.
code_block_port_error: Port name “%1” must be a unique C identifier.
code_block_initial_error: Port “%1” has an invalid initial value for its type.
code_block_connected_port: Port %1 is connected. Remove or move its wire first.
